name: Air Juggler
description: A webcam-controlled browser game where tracked fingertips keep a ball in the air.
summary: Move a tracked fingertip beneath a falling ball to bounce it. Difficulty modes, a timed challenge, pause controls, camera cleanup, and local personal bests complete the browser game loop.
architecture: Browser JavaScript owns camera acquisition, hand tracking, canvas rendering, and round state. TensorFlow.js executes the hand-landmark model; fingertip position drives bounce detection. Personal bests remain in local browser storage, with no backend or accounts.

capabilities.name: Live hand tracking
capabilities.description: Track one hand and its index fingertip through the webcam.

capabilities.name: Juggling modes
capabilities.description: Play three lives-based difficulties or a timed challenge with progressive levels.

capabilities.name: Accessible game controls
capabilities.description: Pause, resume, stop, mute sounds, and release the camera through named controls.

stack.usage: JavaScript coordinates round state, countdowns, gravity, collisions, and camera cleanup.
TensorFlow.js performs in-browser inference for tracked hand landmarks.
Canvas draws ball movement and hand landmark feedback over the camera preview.
Semantic controls, responsive CSS, and reduced-motion styles support the game shell.

architectureConnections.description: Fingertip landmarks feed bounce detection in the game loop.
Round state is drawn as an animated game overlay.

evidence.notes: Reviewed repository README and available dependency manifests. Capabilities describe implemented workflows; roadmap items are excluded.
